projectDescription: A robust C# support library for building RebornBuddy botbases and plugins for Final Fantasy XIV, providing helper functions, remote window wrappers, retainer automation, navigation utilities, and game data access.
keyFeatures: Template botbase and plugin base classes (TemplateBotBase, TemplatePlugin) for rapid RebornBuddy project creation
Retainer automation helpers including RetainerRoutine, RetainerList, and inventory management
Navigation and world travel utilities including teleport helpers, housing navigation, and cross-world travel
Remote window wrappers for 100+ FFXIV UI windows (shops, crafting, grand company, housing, and more)
Script condition helpers for use in RebornBuddy OrderBot profiles
Extension methods for BagSlot, LocalPlayer, ClassJob, inventory items, and game objects
Crafting, gathering, and delivery helper functions
LLogger structured logging system with color support
Safe Mode support for troubleshooting startup issues
NuGet package for compile-time IDE support during development
publicApiSurface: TemplateBotBase — abstract base class for botbases
TemplatePlugin — abstract base class for plugins
ICompiledAsyncBotbase / ICompiledBotbase — interfaces for compiled botbases
TeleportHelper — aetheryte and apartment teleport utilities
Navigation — zone and world travel navigation
RetainerList — access to active retainer data
CraftingHelper — crafting recipe and status helpers
ScriptConditions.Helpers — condition checks for OrderBot profiles
LLogger — structured logging with color output
RemoteWindow wrappers (RetainerList, CollectablesShop, GrandCompanyExchange, InclusionShop, etc.)
Extension methods: BagSlotExtensions, LocalPlayerExtensions, ItemExtensions, ClassJobExtensions
